Hotfix after deploy: PlugRepoScreen accepted only owner/name, causing the app to hang when the operator pasted a full GitHub URL (https://github.com/jav201/s19_app). Added _normalize_repo to accept owner/name, https/git@ URLs, and local paths; updated placeholder/hint; added regression test.

Follow-up hotfix: real GitHub fetch for jav201/s19_app takes ~16s due to multiple gh API calls. Added explicit 'conectando…' message in RepoScreen table, hardened progress callback against exceptions, and added success/error notifications so the UI does not appear frozen during slow fetches.

Pilot reproduction with real repo succeeded: PlugRepoScreen normalizes URL to jav201/s19_app, RepoScreen fetches 9 branches, renders shared time axis. Root cause narrowed to either outdated installed binary or Windows terminal encoding (cp1252) crashing on box-drawing glyphs. Added UTF-8 stdout/stderr wrapper in main() for win32 and 30s subprocess timeouts in github.py to fail fast instead of hanging.
